clue.text: Happen in due course to be less faint!

definitions.meaning: to occur eventually, as a birthday or season does when its time arrives
to recover consciousness after fainting, waking up again

explanation.surface: An instruction to wait patiently, then a jokey order to someone swooning to perk up.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb has two idioms: something arrives in time, and a fainted person regains their senses.

clue.text: Not take responsibility when policeman is dismissed

parts.note: cop is slang for a police officer
a batter who is dismissed in cricket is out

explanation.surface: Someone shirks blame at the moment an officer is sacked.
explanation.definitionFit: A cop-out is an evasion, so to cop out is to dodge a duty or commitment.

clue.text: There are more of us in it

definitions.text: There are more of us in it

parts.words: There are more of us in it
parts.note: spoken by the members of the larger group in a vote: the bigger share of people

explanation.surface: A boast from the bigger side in some gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: The larger number in a vote or group is that side's winning share.

clue.text: Comment concerning first mate on boat

parts.note: re is the Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning

indicators.note: first asks for only the opening letter of the word mate

parts.note: Noah's ark was a boat

explanation.surface: A comment about the ship's first mate aboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first mate' looks like a ship's officer, but 'first' only takes M from 'mate'; 'on' joins M to ARK.
explanation.definitionFit: A passing observation or spoken note is a synonym for a comment.

clue.text: Result of lobbing?

definitions.meaning: a lob sends the ball high in the air, a shot hit skywards

explanation.surface: Asking what comes of hitting a ball high over an opponent.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word in two: a lob is a shot played upward.
explanation.definitionFit: The final outcome of a process is a common synonym for its eventual consequence.

clue.text: Guard the other girl

indicators.note: other tells us to make a different word out of the letters of guard and the

explanation.surface: Someone tells you to protect another young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'other' rearranges GUARD and THE into this word.
explanation.definitionFit: A female child is someone's girl, as parents say of their offspring.

clue.text: No fused section is serviceable

indicators.note: a section of the words no fused is a part cut out of them, so the letters sit inside

explanation.surface: An electrician remarks that a part without fuses works fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'section' picks the letters from inside 'No fused'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something useful or helpful can be put to work, so it is usable or practical.

clue.text: Less than one definite duty at work

indicators.note: less than the word one means the word one is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: the is the definite article in grammar
a duty or task is a job

explanation.surface: A puzzle about having under one clear task to do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Less than one' looks like a number below one, but it means ONE short of its last letter, giving ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Being busy at one's place of employment, actively engaged in a task, is the idiom.

clue.text: More land

parts.note: the imaginary island in Sir Thomas More's 1516 book about an ideal society

explanation.surface: It looks like a request for extra territory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'More' looks like 'extra', but it is Sir Thomas More, the Tudor writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas More named his perfect imaginary island this, and the name now means any ideal place.

clue.text: One sent on an errand as misery develops

indicators.note: develops tells us the letters of as misery grow into a new form

explanation.surface: A messenger is dispatched while gloom spreads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'develops' rearranges AS MISERY.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoy or messenger sent on a mission is a dispatched agent.

clue.text: Nocturnal habits

parts.note: habits here is clothing, as a monk's habit is, worn at night

explanation.surface: It seems to describe a person's night-time routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'habits' wants to mean routines; it means garments, as in a nun's habit.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose sleeping clothes of jacket and trousers are the garments worn in bed.

clue.text: Lofty aspirations?

parts.note: great ambitions, read playfully as leaps that go up high

explanation.surface: It looks like plain talk of grand ambitions.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark hints at a second, literal picture: tall jumps.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means strong optimism about the future, great expectations.

clue.text: Ketch, it was damaged in the trees!

indicators.note: was damaged says the letters of ketch and it are broken and rearranged

explanation.surface: A small sailing boat was wrecked among trees.
explanation.walkthrough: A ketch is a two-masted sailing boat; 'was damaged' rearranges KETCH IT.
explanation.definitionFit: A dense growth of shrubs and trees forms a small wood or copse.

clue.text: Aunt from Madrid embraced Spanish boy in Mexico

definitions.note: points to a place found in that country

indicators.note: embraced means one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: tia is the Spanish word for aunt
Juan is a common Spanish boy's name

explanation.surface: A Spanish aunt hugged a young Spanish lad over in Mexico.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from Madrid' tells you to use the Spanish word for aunt, and 'embraced' signals one piece wrapped around the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A border city in that country, just south of San Diego, California.

clue.text: Dawn's stealing is blatant overcharging

parts.note: dawn is when daylight comes
robbery is stealing

explanation.surface: A woman called Dawn is accused of theft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dawn' looks like a woman's name, but it is daybreak.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a price so steep it feels like open theft.

clue.text: Nothing on heather for young bird

parts.note: a duck is a score of nothing in cricket
ling is a name for common heather

explanation.surface: A chick sitting on a moorland heath plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' joins DUCK to LING.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby waterfowl is the young of a duck.

clue.text: Really much-liked singular item of property

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
effects are personal belongings, so one of them is an effect

explanation.surface: Someone describes a single treasured possession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'personal effects' means belongings, so one item is an EFFECT.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in reality or virtually, the same as actually.

clue.text: Shackle worker on strike

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as a farmhand
to cuff is to hit with an open hand

explanation.surface: A striking labourer is put in chains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on strike' looks like industrial action; 'on' joins HAND to CUFF.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrist manacle locked on a prisoner is a restraint.

clue.text: Quite a variation on formula of parity

indicators.note: a variation on something changes its form, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A tweak to a recipe for balance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variation on' rearranges QUITE A plus ON, the 'on' being part of the letters used.
explanation.definitionFit: A mathematical statement that two expressions are equal sets out a balance.

clue.text: Cold bird is in tank

indicators.note: in puts the word is inside the other letters

parts.note: C is the standard abbreviation for cold on taps
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A chilly bird is sitting in a tank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' here is a container signal, not a link: the word 'is' goes inside the cold-plus-bird pair.
explanation.definitionFit: A water storage container, as in a loft or toilet, is a reservoir.

clue.text: Run one way only

definitions.meaning: a run of one scored in cricket
a ticket for an outward journey without return

explanation.surface: A railway notice warning that a service runs in one direction.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a single is one run; in Britain a one-way ticket is a single.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-run score in cricket and a one-direction ticket share the same everyday term.

clue.text: Taint morally depraved

explanation.surface: A judgement that someone's spoiling influence is wicked.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to pervert or spoil; as an adjective, dishonest or rotten.

clue.text: All-round demonstration of affection

parts.note: a show of fondness in which the arms go right round someone

explanation.surface: It reads as praise for a broad display of love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All-round' sounds like 'versatile' but means arms wrapped round.
explanation.definitionFit: A close embrace with the arms wrapped about someone is a hug.

clue.text: About 100 on greasy surface spring back

parts.note: re means about or concerning
C is the Roman numeral for 100
oil is slippery and greasy

explanation.surface: Something leaps back after roughly a hundred slips on a slick floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' joins C to OIL.
explanation.definitionFit: To flinch or jump backwards, as a gun does on firing, is to rebound.

clue.text: Take most of this the day before

indicators.note: most of the word this means all but its final letter

parts.note: an eve is the day before an event, as Christmas Eve

explanation.surface: Grab nearly all of this on the preceding day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' drops the last letter of 'this'.
explanation.definitionFit: To steal is to take something without permission.

clue.text: Dismal-looking, not looking round?

definitions.meaning: having a face that is not round in shape but stretched

explanation.surface: Someone appearing gloomy because they won't turn their head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'looking round' seems to mean turning to look; it means having a round face.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawn, sad expression stretches the features, so a gloomy person has an elongated face.

clue.text: Chemical produced by team in tube

indicators.note: in places the team's letters within the tube's letters

parts.note: a diode is a kind of electronic valve or tube
XI is eleven in Roman numerals, a football or cricket side

explanation.surface: A substance made by a group of people working inside a tube.
explanation.walkthrough: A diode is an old electronic valve, called a tube in American usage; a cricket or football team has eleven players.
explanation.definitionFit: A compound with two oxygen atoms in each molecule, such as the gas carbon gives off.

clue.text: Visitor who is paying for lodgings

definitions.text: Visitor who is paying for lodgings

parts.words: Visitor who is paying for lodgings
parts.note: a lodger who pays to stay in someone's house, known as a paying one

explanation.surface: A description of a lodger in a boarding house.
explanation.definitionFit: A person staying in a hotel or household is a visitor, and a paying one is a lodger.

clue.text: Swimmer in the country is not under contract

indicators.note: in places the swimmer inside the name of the country

parts.note: France is a country
an eel is a fish that swims

explanation.surface: A swimmer abroad works without a fixed contract.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swimmer' looks like a person in the water; it is a fish, and 'the country' is a specific European nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-employed workers sell services to various clients without permanent employment.
